taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: WebSocket session and message authorization — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect handshake credential/origin processing, subscription registry, message dispatch and session revocation behavior. Identify the protected message operation and object.
controls.controlled_verification: With two controlled accounts, subscribe A to A's private fixture, then request B's channel over the same socket. Observe B's synthetic event or denied subscription. For browser cross-site access, use an owned alternate origin and the actual cookie/handshake behavior, rather than a command-line client that bypasses browser constraints.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A successful upgrade is not access to a protected channel. An origin check does not replace per-message authorization, and token-authenticated nonbrowser designs need their own origin/credential model.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce trusted identity plus subscription/message resource policy and the declared revocation lifetime. Retest an entitled channel, the denied channel and any originally evidenced post-logout behavior.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
